title: Polish Grave Accord first-time play and multiplayer
head: feat/first-playable-loop
body:
Equipment tab switches retain keyboard focus, prerequisite links retain skill scrolling, and existing purchase errors stay readable inside the panel. Arrow keys and Home/End support mirrored direction. Controls stop when their owning panel closes. Prices, prerequisites, progression and multiplayer rules are unchanged.

The branch retains seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons, 66 bosses, six maps and five modes, plus offline Solo, protected waiting rooms, host-only Start/Pause/Continue, confirmed chat, profiles, saves and authority-written records. Earlier accepted language, gallery, camera, lava and recovery changes remain.

Exact product source **9ae3bb92ef201dcc179379815b3bc6f650d24dc3**, build **2026.10.30-equipment-navigation / protocol 43**, passes **922 tests, 922 pass, 0 fail** locally and in both complete source CI jobs: [124299775994](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/41124610624/job/124299775994) and [124299712643](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/41124591510/job/124299712643). TypeScript, authored content/all 15 catalogs/native artwork, production build and 71 atlas contracts pass. [Review evidence](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/tree/feat/first-playable-loop/reviews/equipment-navigation-2026-10-30) binds testing 5258/public 5259, 49 served hashes each, all 15 catalogs and actual two-peer room/password/chat/host/record checks. Wiki **485364abbde495e849ff4bc0f06af5fe906292d8** matches 18 pages/34 images.

The [larger-team software review](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/tree/feat/first-playable-loop/reviews/multiplayer-progression-2026-10-30) passes 8/16/50 clients with mixed builds, input, voting, host transfer, reconnect and persistent results, including 51 historical participants across two roster pages. An earlier 50-client join timeout has an unproven cause despite passing repeats. Protected QA players, accelerated clears/deadlines and zero rendered clients keep this separate from public-score, balance, full endurance and WAN acceptance. Current compiled authority/Session/probe bytes are identical.

The [matching Windows review](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/tree/feat/first-playable-loop/reviews/windows-equipment-navigation-2026-10-30) verifies all 1,899 files before/after six native offline/LAN diagnostics across original, fresh ZIP extraction and independent Japanese-path copy. The **842973815-byte local ZIP** has SHA256 **412313533ae68c02ab8df986610f81cf29aa17f197be615634a99cdfe6f8ca73**. All prior packages and raw failures remain preserved.

Human/rendered/balance/controller/device/listening/native-language, complete action-art, physical second-computer LAN, full progression endurance and WAN/hosted acceptance remain open. Human 5256 feedback accepts the earlier strip removal; this equipment pass awaits human comparison. Browser automation is disabled. Alternate covers, bots/story and gameplay expansion stay deferred. This remains a draft. No main merge, hosted deployment/release replacement or contest submission.
